transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because people keep telling me I’m imagining things, but I know what I’ve seen. The people from the hospital, and some from the agency, they’ve been watching our house and even my cleaning routes. I think they’re checking up on whether I’m taking proper care of my husband.
Can you tell me more about how you know these people are watching you? Have you seen them, or do you just feel like they’re there?

I’ve seen people around, yes. Not always right up close, but enough that I know it’s not just a feeling. Around our house, and then sometimes near where I clean, like they’re keeping track of me. I think it’s people from the hospital and some from the agency, checking whether I’m looking after my husband right.
Can you describe exactly what these people from the hospital and agency look like, and do they ever interact with you or do you only notice them watching from a distance?

I don’t always get a clear look at them. Some are just sitting in cars or standing where they can see the house, and sometimes I notice them near the places I clean. They don’t usually come up and talk to me. It’s more like they’re watching from a distance, keeping track, like they’re checking whether I’m taking care of my husband the right way.
Have you ever felt like you were being watched or followed even when there was no clear reason to believe that was happening?

I mean, I don’t think it’s for no reason. That’s why I’m here. People keep saying I’m imagining it, but I know the hospital people and some from the agency have been watching our house, and even where I go to clean. It feels like they’re checking to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband.
Have you ever had the thought that people were watching you even when there was no clear sign or evidence that they were?

I know you’re asking if there wasn’t evidence, but to me there are signs. I’m here because people keep acting like I’m imagining it, but I know the hospital people and some folks from the agency have been watching our house, and even where I go for cleaning jobs. It feels like they’re checking whether I’m taking proper care of my husband.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts are being controlled by someone else or that events or actions around you have a special meaning specifically for you?

I don’t feel like my thoughts are being controlled, no. But I do feel like what’s happening around me is about me and my husband. Like I said, I’m here because people keep acting like I’m imagining it, but I know the hospital people and some agency folks have been watching our house and even my cleaning routes, to see if I’m taking proper care of him.
Have you ever felt that certain events, actions, or objects in your environment had a special or hidden meaning that was specifically directed at you, even if others didn’t see it that way?

Yes… I mean, that’s what I’ve been trying to explain. Little things around the house or when I’m out on my cleaning routes feel like they’re connected to me. I believe the hospital people and some people from the agency are watching to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband. Other people say I’m imagining it, but it doesn’t feel that way to me.
Can you give me an example of one of these little things that happen around the house or on your cleaning routes that you feel has a special connection to you and your husband?

Like, if I’m leaving for a cleaning job and I see the same car sitting near our house, then later I notice someone near the place I’m cleaning, it feels connected. I feel like they’re from the hospital or the agency, checking on me—checking if I’m doing right by my husband. Other people say I’m making too much of it, but to me it doesn’t feel like a coincidence.
Do you feel that things people say or do in your presence, or things you see on TV or hear on the radio, have a special meaning for you that others don’t seem to notice?

Sometimes, yes. Not so much the TV or radio, but when people are around me, the way they look or talk, it feels like it’s about me and my husband. Like they know something, or they’re checking whether I’m taking care of him right. I know people say I’m imagining it, but I really do think the hospital people and some agency folks have been watching our house and my cleaning routes.
Have you ever felt that things people say or do around you, or things you see in the environment, are directed at you or have a hidden meaning about you, even when others don’t seem to notice it?

Yes. That’s why I’m here, really. People keep saying I’m imagining it, but I know the hospital people and some people from the agency have been watching our house, and sometimes where I go for cleaning work too. It feels like they’re trying to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts are not your own, or that someone is putting thoughts into your mind?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t felt like someone is putting thoughts in my head. My thoughts feel like mine, even when I get worried about what’s going on.
Have you ever felt that random events, comments, or actions by others were directed at you or had a special meaning for you, even when there was no clear connection to your life or situation?

Yes, I have. Like I said, it’s mostly with the hospital people and some folks from the agency. I feel like they’re watching our house, and even the places where I go to clean, to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband. People tell me I’m just imagining it, but it feels directed at me.

Can you tell me more about how you know the people from the hospital and agency are watching you specifically to check on your husband, and whether you believe they have a particular reason or motive to do so?

I just know from how it keeps happening. I see people around the house, and then I notice people near where I go for cleaning jobs too, like they’re keeping track of me. It doesn’t feel random.

I think they believe I’m not taking care of my husband right, or they want to prove something about that. That’s the reason, to check up on me and see what I’m doing. People say I’m imagining it, but I don’t think I am.

Do you believe that these people from the hospital and agency are watching you because they are part of an organized effort against you, or do you think they have a specific role or purpose in monitoring you that goes beyond just checking on your husband?

I don’t know if I’d call it an organized effort against me exactly. What I know is, the hospital people and some people from the agency have been watching our house and watching where I go for my cleaning jobs. It feels like they have a purpose, like they’re checking whether I’m taking proper care of my husband. People keep saying I’m imagining it, but I don’t think I am.

Even though people have told you that you might be imagining these things, do you still believe with absolute certainty that the hospital people and agency folks are watching you to check on your husband?

Yes. I mean, people keep telling me I’m imagining it, but I don’t believe that. I know the hospital people and some people from the agency have been watching our house and where I go for my cleaning work, to see if I’m taking proper care of my husband. That’s why I’m here, because nobody seems to believe me.
